references.source: Microsoft Firewall CSP and MS-GPFAS policy-store contract
references.review: Reviewed domain/private/public registry profile addresses, DWORD state/merge/logging switches, block=1, notification suppression=1, path strings and catalog size bounds. CSP is semantic evidence, not a claim that CSP and GPO stores are interchangeable.
DefaultInboundAction REG_DWORD applies to DomainProfile, PrivateProfile and PublicProfile; 1 blocks inbound traffic.
